info.name: TRADElogs — Trading platform
info.description: Contract tests for account, feedback, strategies and paper runs, marketplace, alerts and screens, journal, trading desk and API keys, exchanges, copy trading and options. Run with apps/api/postman/run-trading.sh against the local test API; nothing here calls an exchange, market data or AI.

item.name: Admin can read the feedback inbox

exec: pm.test("shape", () => { pm.expect(d).to.include({ name: 'Postman A', phone: null, twoFactorEnabled: false, hasPassword: true }); pm.expect(d.signInMethods).to.eql(['password']); });
pm.test("saved", () => { pm.expect(d).to.include({ name: 'Asha P', phone: '+919876543210', timezone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }); });
pm.test("sign-in and profile change are there", () => { const k = d.items.map(i => i.kind); pm.expect(k).to.include('sign_in'); pm.expect(k).to.include('profile_updated'); });
pm.test("free, with limits and what is used", () => { pm.expect(d.plan).to.eql('free'); pm.expect(d.limits.length).to.be.above(3); d.limits.forEach(l => pm.expect(l.used).to.be.a('number')); });
pm.test("no password hashes or tokens", () => { const s = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(s).to.not.match(/"password"\s*:\s*"[^"]|session_token|apiKeyEnc|secretHash/); });
pm.test("listed as new", () => { pm.expect(d[0]).to.include({ kind: 'bug', status: 'new' }); });
pm.test("both there", () => { const ids = d.map(s => s.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('strategyId')); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('copyId')); });
pm.test("no blockers, and a plain-English read-back", () => { pm.expect(d.validation.blockers).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.readback).to.be.ok; });

item.name: Someone else’s list doesn’t show it

exec: pm.test("its rules and interval", () => { pm.expect(d.spec).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(d.interval).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test("stopping (the next tick settles it; the scheduler is off here)", () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.be.oneOf(['stopping', 'stopped']); });

item.name: Activity shows start, size, pause and stop

exec: pm.test("in order", () => { const k = d.items.map(i => i.kind); ['deployment_started', 'deployment_changed', 'deployment_stopped'].forEach(x => pm.expect(k).to.include(x)); });

item.name: Price alert on someone else’s account → 404

exec: pm.test("each says what it is, why it matters and the catch", () => { pm.expect(d.length).to.be.above(10); d.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.explain.what).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(r.explain.why).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(r.explain.caution).to.be.a('string'); }); });

item.name: Journal entry on someone else’s account → 404

exec: pm.test("empty, not an error", () => { pm.expect(d.positions).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.errors).to.eql([]); });

item.name: Order on an account that isn’t yours → 404

exec: pm.test("the key is shown once", () => { pm.expect(d.key).to.match(/^tl_/); pm.expect(d.scope).to.eql('read'); });
